name: Lamp of Salvation
descriptionTemplate:
After the battle starts, gain 5 stacks of "{Lost}," and reduce 1 stack for every 3 Command Cards played.
After all "{Lost}" are removed, all Awakeners gain 100 Aliemus. For every 3 cards played, recover [Arg1] HP and apply {Corrosion} equal to 1% of the enemy's Max HP to the front-row enemy.
lore: Even though the experience is dim, the lantern of salvation will ultimately shine bright again amidst death.
